steps.name: project-init
steps.summary: Next 16 + TS strict + Tailwind 4 scaffold (package.json, tsconfig, next.config, postcss, eslint v9 flat, prettier, .nvmrc, app/globals.css 빈 베이스) 생성, npm install 완료

steps.name: app-shell
steps.summary: RootLayout(lang=ko, class=dark, theme-color #0a0a0a, Pretendard fallback chain), 홈 placeholder, 404 not-found, globals.css에 @theme tokens + typing-dot keyframes 추가; lint/tsc/build 통과

steps.name: shadcn-ui
steps.summary: shadcn/ui new-york style 초기화 (components.json, lib/utils.ts) + 13개 컴포넌트(button/input/textarea/select/label/sheet/popover/scroll-area/carousel/form/radio-group/card/sonner) 생성, lucide-react/cva 의존성 추가, ESLint override(components/ui/** react-hooks/set-state-in-effect off); lint/tsc/build 통과

steps.name: hono-mount
steps.summary: Hono 4.12 의존성 추가, Edge runtime 라우트(app/api/[[...route]]/route.ts: GET /api/health, POST /api/chat 501)와 Node runtime 라우트(app/api/node/[[...route]]/route.ts: GET /api/node/health, POST /api/node/feedback 501, POST /api/node/contact 501) 분리 마운트; tsc/lint/build 통과, AC curl 6종 모두 정상 응답
